unit.why: A short memorate: the tzaddik's mother tells her son she saw her late father the Maggid and the Seer of Lublin standing beside him during the Kedusha, and he confirms it.
unit.boundary_note: One of a numbered series of anecdotes about the tzaddik's mother; it is self-contained.

stories.start_quote: פ"א אמרה אל בנה הצדיק מרן
stories.end_quote: שיש לו סימנים כי אמת הדבר
stories.summary_en: The tzaddik's mother tells him that while he recited the Kedusha of Keter she saw her father the holy Maggid on one side of him and the holy Seer of Lublin on the other, and the tzaddik says he has signs that this is true.

tags.why: The mother is the one who sees the vision and tells it.
The vision occurs during the Kedusha prayer.
